af_f3_seasons.reason: How many consecutive growth seasons of adequate light at the bed, with cover still absent, the F3 block test asks for: a design choice, long enough for eelgrass to have had time to return, not a measured recovery time.

af_f3_min_shift_years.reason: The smallest circular shift, in whole years, in the F3 temporal null: a design choice, so that a shifted series is never paired with its own neighbouring year.

af_f3_draws.reason: Draws in the F3 temporal null: a design choice; a permutation p-value can resolve no finer than one over the draws plus one.

af_f3_depth_band_m.reason: The width, in metres, of the bottom-depth bands within which the F3 spatial null relabels cover loss: a design choice, narrow enough to hold depth nearly fixed.

af_f3_join_km.reason: The radius, in kilometres, within which a light cast is joined to a transect in the F3 test: a design choice; beyond it clarity comes from satellite pixels, and the share of transects the radius keeps is reported with the result.

af_f3_lag_lo.reason: The shortest lag, in years, of the F3 cross-lagged regression: a design choice, the first year a change in cover could show in clarity.

af_f3_lag_hi.reason: The longest lag, in years, of the F3 cross-lagged regression: a design choice, long enough for a slow response and short enough to keep most transect series usable.

af_f3_cover_pct.reason: The cover, in percent, below which a transect counts as cover-absent in the F3 block test: a design choice, not a threshold from the monitoring programme.

af_f3_req_lo_pct.reason: The lower end, as a percentage of surface light at the bed, of the eelgrass requirements the F3 block test is run across: a design range bracketing the two values light.py carries, for which no source is pinned; it measures how far the adequacy call moves with the requirement, not the requirement.

af_f3_req_hi_pct.reason: The upper end, as a percentage of surface light at the bed, of the eelgrass requirements the F3 block test is run across: a design range bracketing the two values light.py carries, for which no source is pinned; it measures how far the adequacy call moves with the requirement, not the requirement.

af_c1_boot.reason: Bootstrap draws over stations for the thermodynamic null of the C1 test: a design choice.

af_c1_perm.reason: Shuffles within strata for the design null of the C1 test: a design choice.

af_c1_pct.reason: The percentile of bottom oxygen, within a station and calendar month, below which a cast counts as low in the C1 floor test: a design choice. A shuffle that ignored the other stratification would put the expected share at that percentile itself.
